acceptanceCriteria: impact's untracked-path refusal names the untracked path, labels the snapshot correctly (working-tree tree vs commit) and states the stage/commit next step, with a test.
body: Found during the Beamfall plugin AGENTS.md rollout (2026-10-20, corvint 1.0.0-rc.3 build 676). In a linked worktree of beamfall-plugin-sdk (HEAD 413817a), `corvint --root <wt> impact AGENTS.md` on a newly created, unstaged AGENTS.md returned rc 2 `impact paths are not tracked at revision d687e4d...`. d687e4d is a Git tree object (the worktree snapshot), not a commit, so the message reads as a wrong revision. Expected: the refusal names the path as untracked, identifies the snapshot as the working tree (or HEAD), and says to stage or commit; or impact gives an advisory result for an untracked path. Related: V1-0450 (OpenCode file-change refuses untracked paths).
title: impact on a new untracked file refuses with 'not tracked at revision <tree>' naming a worktree tree hash, not HEAD, and no next step
